summary: monster truck: a pickup-like body high on long-travel suspension and huge wheels; the suspension, axles and chassis rails are the show and are required from the simple level.

overall.summary: the whole model: 3/4 front and rear, side, front, rear, top

front.summary: nose: bumper, grille, lamps, bonnet front edge, plate

rear.summary: tail: bumper, lamps, boot or tailgate, plate, exhaust tip

sides.summary: flanks: doors, handles, mirrors, glass, mouldings, sills, fuel flap

roof.summary: roof, pillars and what sits on the roof

wheels.summary: wheels, arches, liners, the suspension and brakes seen through the arches

underside.summary: from below and a low camera: floor, exhaust, tanks, axles

interior.summary: through the glass and with the doors open: seats, dash, door cards, wheel

engine_bay.summary: with the bonnet open: engine, radiator, battery, bay walls

notes: Rename items to the real design ('Front bumper with a centre air intake'), add what the design has with keys of your own (roof rack, bull bar, side steps), split an item when a reviewer could point at its halves.
Never drop a starter item silently: delete it only with a 'waived' entry {key, why} (asset.inventory reports dropped keys; the strict check blocks them).
Tag the built geometry with scene.tag (whole objects, or faces with a select) as you build; an item counts as built only when its own geometry carries its id and touches what it attaches to.

items.name: Body shell (chassis)
items.construction: one welded half shell lofted from shape sections (mesh.loft, 8-10 stations, half + MIRROR): roof crown, pillars with tumblehome, fenders, quarters, nose and tail; panels are cut from it, never laid on top

items.name: Wheel (one model the game clones to the four dummies)
items.construction: kit.wheel or mesh.lathe tyre profile with a rounded shoulder, a rim face and a hub; sized by wheel_scale

items.name: Chassis rails and crossmembers
items.construction: two rails swept along the length with crossmembers, carrying the body high above the axles

items.name: Wheel arches with liners
items.construction: round arch cuts with 5-8 segments over the top, a short return face and a liner plate inside (mesh.flare liner=true, or the blank's arches); flares grow out of the shell's own faces; nothing seen through

items.name: Bonnet
items.construction: cut from the shell (kit.blank_split part or the bonnet faces split off) so its edge lies on the shell; keeps the crown and the creases

items.name: Tailgate or bed
items.construction: pickup bed tub with a tailgate cut from it, or the rear of the body

items.name: Front doors
items.construction: cut from the shell along the shut lines; belt line and mouldings continue across the cut

items.name: Front bumper
items.construction: mesh.sweep of a soft 2-4 segment profile wrapping from arch to arch, its top on the body line (mesh.attach snap)

items.name: Rear bumper
items.construction: mesh.sweep of a soft profile wrapping from arch to arch under the tail

items.name: Windscreen
items.construction: glass pane filling the shell opening, its rim on the frame (alpha glass material)

items.name: Side windows
items.construction: panes set into the door and quarter openings a little inside the frame (glass material)

items.name: Rear window
items.construction: pane in the rear opening or the tailgate, rim on the frame

items.name: Closed floor pan
items.construction: floor of the body closed above the chassis rails

items.name: Cabin floor and footwells
items.construction: the cabin tub seen through the glass: floor, footwells, transmission tunnel

items.name: Axles and differentials
items.construction: solid axle tubes with differential housings front and rear (transmission frames)

items.name: Shocks, springs and links
items.construction: coil-overs or shocks and trailing links from the rails to each axle (sweeps, lathes)

items.name: Headlamps
items.construction: lenses set into recessed buckets (inset, then extrude inward) on the headlight key colours of vehiclelights128

items.name: Tail lamps
items.construction: lenses in recessed housings on the taillight key colours, reverse and indicator sections included

items.name: Grille
items.construction: recessed grille panel with bars or teeth (inset, extrude in, bars from sweeps) in a surround

items.name: Door mirrors
items.construction: rounded_box head on a short stalk that touches the door (mesh.attach snap), glass face on vehiclelights128

items.name: Door handles
items.construction: small pieces sitting on each door skin (rounded_box + mesh.attach snap) or recessed pull pockets
items.notes: one per door: count 4 on a four-door body

items.name: Number plates
items.construction: 4-8 triangle cards on carplate / carpback set onto the bumpers or the tail panel

items.name: Exhaust tip
items.construction: a lathe tube end under the rear bumper at the exhaust dummy, its open end dark

items.name: Front seats
items.construction: cushion, backrest and headrest as soft lofted or rounded_box volumes standing on the floor

items.name: Dashboard
items.construction: dash top swept across the cabin with an instrument binnacle and a centre stack, meeting the windscreen base and the A-pillars

items.name: Steering wheel and column
items.construction: rim from mesh.lathe or a sweep around a circle, 2-3 spokes, a column into the dash

items.name: Door inner panels
items.construction: inner faces of each door with an armrest and a pull: an open door is never see-through

items.name: Wipers
items.construction: thin arm and blade pieces resting on the scuttle below the windscreen

items.name: Front indicators
items.construction: amber lenses set 2-3 mm into the front corners or the headlamp cluster (inset, push in) on the amber lamp key colour

items.name: Side mouldings and sills
items.construction: rub strip or crease at one height across fenders and doors (inset strip or a sweep), a sill under the doors

items.name: Window frames and black-outs
items.construction: dark bands around the side glass and on the B-pillars standing 3-5 mm off the skin (inset, extrude out, dark trim material)

items.name: Fuel filler flap
items.construction: a shallow inset flap on a rear quarter at the petrolcap dummy

items.name: Badges and emblems
items.construction: maker badge on the grille and the boot, model script: a small card standing 2-3 mm off the surface (inset, extrude out)

items.name: Rear-view mirror
items.construction: small rounded head on a stem at the top of the windscreen

items.name: Instrument dials
items.construction: gauge faces in the binnacle: cards or texture on own faces

items.name: Rim face detail
items.construction: spokes or a dished face with a hub cap and wheel nuts on the rim (part of the wheel model)

items.name: Roll bar or light bar
items.construction: tube bar swept over the cab or the bed with lamps on it

items.name: Engine bay walls and firewall
items.construction: inner fender walls, firewall and radiator support closing the bay: no see-through with the bonnet open

items.name: Engine
items.construction: block and head as soft rounded volumes with a cam cover, intake manifold and pulleys, seated in the bay

items.name: Radiator and fan
items.construction: radiator core behind the grille with a fan shroud, upper and lower hoses

items.name: Battery
items.construction: rounded_box with terminals on a tray in the bay

items.name: Air filter and intake
items.construction: air box (rounded_box) and an intake hose swept to the engine

items.name: Hoses, reservoirs and wiring
items.construction: mesh.sweep tubes between the parts, fluid reservoirs as soft boxes on the bay walls

items.name: Exhaust system
items.construction: pipe swept along a path from the engine to the tip with a muffler and hangers

items.name: Fuel tank
items.construction: soft box tucked under the rear floor

items.name: Brake discs and calipers
items.construction: lathe disc and a caliper behind the rim spokes (in the wheel model)

items.name: Seat belts
items.construction: flat strap cards from the B-pillar to the buckle beside each front seat

items.name: Pedals
items.construction: small pads on arms in the driver's footwell

items.name: Centre console
items.construction: console between the front seats from the dash to the armrest

items.name: Gear lever and handbrake
items.construction: lever with a knob and a boot on the console, handbrake lever beside it

items.name: Sun visors
items.construction: thin soft panels at the top of the windscreen

items.name: Roof lining
items.construction: inside faces of the roof and pillars seen through the glass

items.name: Parcel shelf or load floor
items.construction: shelf behind the rear seat or the floor of the load area

items.name: Lamp reflectors and bezels
items.construction: reflector bowls inside the lamp buckets and a chrome or black bezel around each lamp

items.name: Roof details
items.construction: antenna, roof rails, gutter strips or a sunroof as the design shows

items.name: Fog or driving lamps
items.construction: small lenses set into the bumper

items.name: Mud flaps
items.construction: thin flaps behind the wheels on the arch lip

items.name: Tow hook or hitch
items.construction: hook or ball hitch under the rear bumper

items.name: Skid plates and steering linkage
items.construction: plates under the front, steering rods to the knuckles

views_note: views name the close-up regions of 'blender preview --regions' (data/kit/regions/mtruck.json) that show each region; 'overall' with no views = the standard preview sheet
